name: FV_BE_TRANSACTION_HEADERS
description: This table contains budget  transaction header information.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_ID
columns.description: Internal identifier associated with the budget document.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_NUMBER
columns.description: Unique document number associated with budget document

columns.name: REVISION_NUMBER
columns.description: The number of the last revision created for the budget document.

columns.name: INTERNAL_REVISION_NUMBER
columns.description: Internal revision number of the budget document.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Statement that describes the document.

columns.name: FUND_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Funding status of the budget document. The value will be one  look up code from lookup type XCC_BC_FUNDS_STATUSES and valid values are IN_PROCESS,NOT_RESERVED_PASSED,NOT_RESERVED_FAILED,RESERVED_PASSED,NOT_RESERVED_PARTIAL

columns.name: BUDGET_LEVEL_ID
columns.description: Budget level identifier for the budget document.

columns.name: LEVEL_NUM
columns.description: Budget level squence identifier assigned for the budget document

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Ledger identifier associated to the budget document.

columns.name: SOURCE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Source associated with this budget document.The value will be one of the look up code from lookup type ORA_FV_SOURCE_CODE and valid values are MANUAL,IMPORT,ANTICIPATED

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_DATE
columns.description: Date when the budget transaction was last accounted.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Accounting status of the budget document.The value will be one  look up code from lookup type ORA_FV_ACCOUNTING_STATUS  and valid values are  UNACCOUNTED,DRAFT, SELECTED,ACCOUNTED,PARTIALLY_ACCOUNTED,NOT_REQUIRED

columns.name: APPROVAL_STATUS_CODE
columns.description:
Approval status of the budget document.The value will be one  look up code from lookup type ORA_FV_APPROVAL_STATUS and valid values are UNACCOUNTED
DRAFT, SELECTED,ACCOUNTED,PARTIALLY_ACCOUNTED,NOT_REQUIRED

columns.name: APPROVAL_DATE
columns.description: The date on which the budget document is approved.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Total amount of all the transaction lines for the budget document.

columns.name: APPROVAL_ID
columns.description: Document approval process identifier.

columns.name: APPROVED_BY_USER
columns.description: User that approved the budget document. This will be updated every time user approves the document.

columns.name: CANCELLED_BY
columns.description: Budget user who cancelled this budget transaction document.

columns.name: CANCELLED_DATE
columns.description: Date on which the budget transaction document was cancelled.

columns.name: CANCELLED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates the cancellation status of the budget transaction document. Valid values are N , Y and null.

columns.name: DEFAULT_BUDGETARY_CTL_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Default identifier associated to the transaction line that will derive a control budget.

columns.name: DEFAULT_TRANSACTION_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Default identifier for budgetary debit and credit accounts to be used for this transaction line.

columns.name: PARENT_BUDGET_DEFAULT_CCID
columns.description: Default parent budget level account combination for a budget transaction line.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_DATE
columns.description: Date on which the transaction occurred.

columns.name: BUDGET_CATEGORY_CODE
columns.description: Budget category code for the transaction.

columns.name: BUDGET_CODE_COMBINATION_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the budget code combination.
